paksa-hindi-buong-ideya.wrongChoice: Tumutulong ang malinaw na tungkulin sa pagpapatuloy ng gawain.
paksa-hindi-buong-ideya.mistakeNote: A full statement about the topic was chosen when only the topic name was asked.

detalye-hindi-pangunahing-ideya.wrongChoice: Ang pinakamahalagang layunin ng hardin ay ang pagdami ng talaan.
detalye-hindi-pangunahing-ideya.mistakeNote: A tool (the record) was made the main goal instead of the whole passage's point.

detalye-bilang-pamagat.wrongChoice: Paglalagay ng pisara: pagbabago ng tanggapan at hiwalay na mesa.
detalye-bilang-pamagat.mistakeNote: One detail (the board) was made the main idea of the outline.

dito-ay-bunga.wrongChoice: Ipinapakilala nito ang sanhi ng unang pagtatayo ng tanggapan.
dito-ay-bunga.mistakeNote: A sentence starting with Dahil dito gives a result, but was read as a cause.

hindi-ayon-sa-oras.wrongChoice: Inilalarawan nito ang pangyayaring naganap bago ang lahat ng pagbabago.
hindi-ayon-sa-oras.mistakeNote: The result sentence was placed before the changes, as if paragraph order were event order.

hinuha-na-walang-batayan.wrongChoice: Palitan ang lahat ng kawani na sumasagot sa mga tanong.
hinuha-na-walang-batayan.mistakeNote: Adds a decision about staff that no detail in the passage supports.

hinuha-na-lampas-sa-teksto.wrongChoice: Hindi na kailanman mangangailangan ng tulong ang mga bisita.
hinuha-na-lampas-sa-teksto.mistakeNote: Stretches 'more visitors' to 'never' beyond what the text says.

isang-detalye-lamang.wrongChoice: Ang talaan ng silid ay inilagay sa tabi ng pasukan.
isang-detalye-lamang.mistakeNote: A true detail chosen as the implied main idea, but it covers only one part of the passage.

hindi-sakop-ng-pagsubok.wrongChoice: Napatunayan ang pakinabang para sa bawat bago at sanay na kawani.
hindi-sakop-ng-pagsubok.mistakeNote: Extends a result from experienced staff only to new staff who were not tested.

kulang-hindi-walang-bisa.wrongChoice: Napatunayang walang pakinabang ang mga bagong lalagyan.
kulang-hindi-walang-bisa.mistakeNote: Limited evidence was read as proof of no benefit.

iisang-sanhi.wrongChoice: Ang mga lalagyan lamang ang maaaring sanhi ng mas maayos na trabaho.
iisang-sanhi.mistakeNote: Names one cause although another change (staff experience) happened at the same time.

ugaling-hindi-ipinakita.mistakeNote: A trait the passage never shows was chosen because receipts relate to payment.

literal-lamang.mistakeNote: Only the literal meaning of suyod (hair comb) was used; envelopes are being searched, not hair.
